verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Payment Links API for creating payment links programmatically. Its official MCP server exposes that API, so an agent can create a payment link in a single session. The evidence shows no product or price catalog API, so the agent cannot provision product and price objects, and the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: a documented Products API, a documented Prices API, an evidenced end-to-end agent flow linking product, price and payment link, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: With the Payment Links API you can generate a payment link to share with your customer.

Currently, the following APIs are available: Balances API, Captures API, Customers API, Invoices API, Mandates API, Methods API, Payments API, Payment Links API, Settlements API, Subscriptions API, Terminals API, Webhooks API, Webhook Events API.
The Mollie MCP server enables merchants to use various AI tools like Claude Desktop and Cursor AI to utilize natural language for creating different resources in their Mollie account.
